observations: Photo 0 shows a black Sony PlayStation 4 console lying on its side, with a controller resting on top of it.
The console shell has a dark decal/print design (appears Batman-themed) partially covering the front panel; this could hide scratches or wear underneath.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or box is visible in the photo.
No screen-on shot showing a home menu or games list is visible.
A watermark reading 'SNYZ GADGET HOME' overlays the image; this is the seller's own branding, not proof of anything.
Only one controller is visible; the listing says 'pad' (singular), consistent with this.

claims.claim: USA used ps4 console and pad
claims.evidence: No region marking, serial plate, or box is visible in photo 0 to confirm origin or usage history.
No screen-on photo or menu screenshot showing installed games is provided.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (common issue with used PS4 units, e.g. HDD or disc drive failure).
risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on, showing the PS4 home screen and the games list.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / functionality unverified

risks.risk: Controller may have stick drift, worn buttons, or battery/charging issues.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the controller connected and used in a game, including analog stick movement.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / functionality unverified

risks.risk: Decal/skin on the shell may be concealing scratches, cracks, or sun damage to the plastic casing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the shell with the decal partially peeled back or from multiple angles without glare.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn/damaged, worst case

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable) could mean extra cost for buyer.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console and pad only, no cables included

risks.risk: Storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) is unknown, which affects value.
risks.proof: A photo of the system settings/storage screen or the rear label showing capacity.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the installed games menu.
Video of the controller being used, including stick and button response.
Close-up photos of the shell surface around and under the decal.
Photo of all included accessories (cables, box if any).
Photo of the storage/settings screen or rear label showing HDD capacity.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used PS4 console with one controller, but functionality, storage capacity, and true cosmetic condition under the decal are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
